description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Method for determination of Customs Value for disposal of Vehicles imported and registered on or before 19.11.2015 on 100% Duty/Tax free Basis by the Diplomats & Diplomatic Organizations
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes a method for determining customs value for disposal of vehicles imported duty-free by diplomats, under the authority of the Customs (Amendment) Act. It contains regulatory provisions, calculation methods, and rescinds a previous notification, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter concerning customs procedures and valuation rules.
